scientific_integrity: The exact statement follows from parity anticommutation and positivity of pairing with the defining linear form; a finite exact arithmetic program supplies corroborating spot checks but is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Requires a uniform Boolean cube and a homogeneous linear halfspace with no tied vertices; makes no claim of sharpness of the margin coefficient or explicit noncentral eigenvalues. Residual possible equivalent formulation in earlier threshold-function literature.
title: Half-energy spectral rigidity for Walsh concentration on homogeneous halfspaces
